steps.caption: Citations
steps.narration: Citations is a checklist of the main business directories, kept per location.

steps.caption: Collapse the sub-menu
steps.narration: Collapse the sub-menu to give the table more room.

steps.caption: Open the campaign
steps.narration: Open the campaign from its card.

steps.caption: Build checklist
steps.narration: Choose Build checklist. It lists thirty sites contractors should be on, Google first.

steps.caption: Google: filled from your listing
steps.narration: The Google Business Profile row fills in from your linked listing, marked Listed.

steps.caption: Search finds you on that site
steps.narration: For every other site, Search looks for your business there through Google.

steps.caption: Mark what you found
steps.narration: Then mark what you found: listed, listed with wrong details, or not listed.

steps.caption: Paste the listing link
steps.narration: Paste the link to your listing there.

steps.caption: Saved on the row
steps.narration: Press Enter and the link is saved on the row.

steps.caption: The tiles keep count
steps.narration: The tiles keep the count: two listed, twenty-eight still to check.

steps.caption: Menu: Locations
steps.narration: You'll find Locations in the Google Business menu on the left.
